name: Plan weekly content from rising Google Trends and news with Apify, OpenAI and Google Sheets

parameters.content:
## Plan weekly content from rising Google Trends and news with Apify, OpenAI and Google Sheets

Every week, find the searches that are starting to grow around your topics, read the news explaining why, and get ranked content ideas in a Google Sheets calendar and a clean email digest. Publish what people are about to look for, before your competitors do.

### Who's it for
- Bloggers, YouTubers and creators planning their next pieces
- SEO and content marketing teams building an editorial calendar
- Agencies and small businesses that want timely, data-backed posts

### How it works
1. Runs every Monday, or anytime from a **form** (type a few topics, get ideas a minute later).
2. The [Google Trends API](https://apify.com/inter974/google-trends-api) Actor returns the searches rising around your topics. Google's spam-like breakouts are filtered out, and searches already covered in previous weeks are skipped.
3. The [Google News Scraper](https://apify.com/inter974/google-news-scraper) Actor finds the latest articles behind each search, with their real URLs.
4. Each search gets a **priority score** from the data: search growth, press coverage and the topic's momentum.
5. OpenAI writes one idea per search through a **structured output parser**: title, format, target search, why now and a 3-point outline.
6. The ideas are added to your **Google Sheets content calendar** (with a Status column) and sent in a designed email, ranked by priority.

### How to set up
1. Create a free Apify account and copy your API token (Settings → API & Integrations).
2. In **Get rising searches**, create a *Bearer Auth* credential with the token. Select the same credential in **Find the news behind each search**.
3. Connect OpenAI in **OpenAI Chat Model** (n8n's free OpenAI credits work).
4. In **Add to content calendar**, connect Google Sheets and pick an empty spreadsheet: columns are created on the first run.
5. Connect Gmail in **Send ideas by Gmail**, edit **Your settings** and click *Execute workflow*.

### Requirements
- An Apify account. A weekly run costs about $0.06, covered by the free plan's monthly credits.
- An OpenAI account (one gpt-5-mini call per run).
- Google Sheets and Gmail accounts.

### How to customize the workflow
- Change the prompt in **Write content ideas** to match your brand voice, or swap the model for Claude, Gemini or Mistral.
- Write the ideas in any language and for any country.
- Send the digest to Slack, Notion or Trello instead of Gmail.

## 1. Your topics
Runs **every Monday at 8:00**, or anytime from the **form** (open it from the form node: type a few topics, get ideas by email a minute later).

Edit **Your settings**: topics, country, audience (who reads or watches your content), language, ideas per week and your email.

## 2. Find what is rising, and why
[Google Trends API](https://apify.com/inter974/google-trends-api) returns the searches growing around your topics (Google's spam-like breakouts are filtered out). Searches already covered in previous weeks are **skipped**, so every week brings fresh ideas. [Google News Scraper](https://apify.com/inter974/google-news-scraper) then finds the articles behind each new search, and every search gets a **priority score** from the data: growth, press coverage and the topic's momentum.

**Credential**: one *Bearer Auth* with your Apify API token, used by both requests.

## 3. Turn the data into ideas
OpenAI writes one idea per search. A **structured output parser** guarantees clean data: title, format, target search, why now and a 3-point outline.

Works with n8n's free OpenAI credits.

## 4. Plan and deliver
The ideas are added to your **Google Sheets content calendar** (with a Status column to track them) and sent in a designed email, ranked by priority.

**Tip**: in the sheet, select all, then Format → Wrapping → Wrap and View → Freeze → 1 row, to read every idea at a glance.

messageValues.message:
You are a senior content strategist.
Using ONLY the Google Trends and news data provided, propose content ideas that ride what people are starting to search for.
Rules:
- Each idea targets one search copied exactly from a 'Search:' line of the data (targetSearch). Use each search only once and start with the highest priority searches.
- title: specific and click-worthy, written for the final reader. Never generic, and never mention the format in the title.
- format: exactly one of "Blog post", "YouTube video", "Short video", "Social post", "Newsletter". Pick the best fit for the search and mix formats.
- whyNow: one or two sentences on why this is the right moment, based on the search growth and, when available, a recent headline (name the outlet, no dates).
- outline: exactly 3 short points: the main sections of the piece, as the final reader will see them. No production, filming, SEO or monetization tips.
- Never invent numbers, searches or news that are not in the data. Write in the requested language, for the requested audience.
